text: Projected real GDP growth for 2024 has been revised down to 3.0 percent due to softening tourism. Year-on-year inflation is projected to reach 2.5 percent by December 2024. Staff assess that the monetary policy stance appears accommodative, though monetary transmission remains weak. The external current account deficit is expected to widen to 10.7 percent of GDP in 2024. Meanwhile, capex plans may still be under-executed, and public and publicly guaranteed debt is projected to rise to 61.5 percent of GDP by end-2024.
